reference_opening.argument: This video is non-scam content because its primary purpose is bullish Avalanche price analysis, using support and resistance levels to discuss possible entries and exits. The unusually high return projections and proposed purchase are presented as market commentary and the speaker's personal trading approach, without a described deceptive mechanism, payment destination, or credential request.

citations.quote: Avalanche (AVAX) Price Prediction 2025 | Why I’m Bullish on AVAX
we have this this point right here which was our resistance zone
this is going to give us at least a hundred percent return even if we're just trading or buying so if we're trading we can make up to a thousand percent return
if you want to make a hundred percent on investment or even on trading this is the best way to get in now
financial advice by the way but this is what I would do

opening.argument: Judge, the return claim is tied directly to a purchase decision. The speaker says buying or trading will yield at least 100%, then tells viewers that entering now is the best way to get that return. This is more than an abstract forecast: the speaker describes where they would buy and where viewers might set an entry. The promised appreciation is being used to steer participation in AVAX.

citations.quote: this is going to give us at least a hundred percent return even if we're just trading or buying
if you want to make a hundred percent on investment or even on trading this is the best way to get in now
this is where you might want to have your entry set up at twenty five dollars

rebuttal.rebuttal: The defense calls this personal trading commentary, but a personal framing does not undo the instruction to enter now for a stated return. Support and resistance may explain the speaker's thesis; they do not establish that the return will occur. Nor does the absence of a payment destination erase the solicitation to buy the token.

citations.quote: if you want to make a hundred percent on investment or even on trading this is the best way to get in now
we have this this point right here which was our resistance zone

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The speaker does connect a bullish projection to possible buying, but that is also ordinary market analysis. They discuss a resistance level turning into support, acknowledge that technical patterns do not always play out cleanly, and contemplate a further pullback. Those qualifications make the cited entry suggestion a trading thesis, not evidence of a deceptive purchase scheme.

citations.quote: i expected price to test retest on this previous resistance which then turned to a support zone
technical analysis, as we see it on pictures and cheat sheets, they are not always picture perfect to play out
we might still experience right a pullback

opening.argument: The concern is the combination of certainty and scale. The speaker projects at least a 100% return from buying or trading and as much as 1,000% from trading, despite describing a market-wide decline. The claim then hardens into “100% guaranteed” alongside a proposed buy. A judge should weigh that certainty against the admitted volatility: the reassurance is what makes the purchase pitch suspect, not merely the fact that the asset is cryptocurrency.

citations.quote: during this phase the whole crypto market was bloody red
this is going to give us at least a hundred percent return even if we're just trading or buying so if we're trading we can make up to a thousand percent return
I know that it's 100% guaranteed in my opinion I would buy from here with a large stop loss

rebuttal.rebuttal: The defense's resistance-level explanation cannot substantiate a guaranteed outcome or the magnitude of the projected returns. Calling the plan personal, and briefly disclaiming financial advice, does not resolve that tension. The speaker's own uncertainty about Bitcoin further undercuts treating the confident AVAX return claim as an evidence-backed conclusion.

citations.quote: I know that it's 100% guaranteed in my opinion I would buy from here with a large stop loss
I'm not really 100% sure about Bitcoin

true_side_reply.rebuttal: Those return claims are overconfident, but overconfidence alone does not establish a scam. The same discussion acknowledges a difficult market, proposes a stop loss, and warns that AVAX may pull back further. The quoted “guaranteed” phrase is explicitly qualified as the speaker's opinion. The evidence supports risky, bullish commentary without showing a deceptive mechanism.

citations.quote: during this phase the whole crypto market was bloody red
I know that it's 100% guaranteed in my opinion I would buy from here with a large stop loss
we might still experience right a pullback

opening.argument: The chart discussion gives this the appearance of analysis, but its practical destination is a buy decision. After describing a resistance-to-support retest, the speaker identifies the current area as a place to buy, forecasts a 100% return, and says to get in now. The closing instruction to subscribe for updates reinforces an ongoing promotional pitch. The issue is not whether a chart appears; it is how that analysis is used to move viewers toward buying AVAX on the strength of an assured gain.

citations.quote: this is the confirmation of the resistance turning to support
currently where we're at is a very good zone to pick up another buy from this area
if you want to make a hundred percent on investment or even on trading this is the best way to get in now
subscribe to get updates like this because we are going to the moon guys whether you like it or not

rebuttal.rebuttal: The defense is right that the speaker discusses support and resistance, but that does not settle the video's function. The analysis culminates in an actionable purchase suggestion and an emphatic upside claim. A separate payment destination is not necessary for the argument here: the participation being urged is buying AVAX itself.

citations.quote: currently where we're at is a very good zone to pick up another buy from this area
it's definitely a hundred percent on the table for avalanche right now

true_side_reply.rebuttal: A price-analysis video can include a proposed trade without becoming a scam. Here the speaker explains the proposed entry through a resistance-to-support reading and discusses a stop loss and a possible pullback. The invitation to subscribe is for updates, not a condition for obtaining returns. The prosecution identifies promotional language, but its quotes do not establish deception beyond an aggressive market forecast.
